run_openclaw_migration: run the openclaw_to_hermes migration with --execute to dry-run migration from ~/.openclaw to ~/.hermes
run_migration_selective: run the openclaw_to_hermes migration with --include memory,skills --exclude provider-keys to migrate only selected options
run_migration_with_preset: run the openclaw_to_hermes migration using --preset full to apply all compatible migration groups
migrate_soul_and_memory: migrate OpenClaw SOUL.md and MEMORY.md into Hermes with rebranding and entry merging
migrate_channel_settings: migrate Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, and Signal bot tokens and allowlists into Hermes .env
